reviewDecisions.rationale: Repeated specialist evidence shows a persistent physical shortage and large realized price changes; deep research must independently verify company exposure, timing and asymmetry.
Two independent first-party suppliers confirm persistent global order/backlog strength; company-level timing/asymmetry still required.
Policy expectations moved prices, but official PPI remained broadly deflationary and the beneficiary map is too broad.
Concentrate scarcity and record refined output imply opposite effects for mines/smelters; no clean A-share direction is frozen.
Strategic supply control is real and independently evidenced; deep research must determine whether any listed company actually retains the economics.
AI/high-end demand remains strong against weak broad manufacturing/consumer demand; company mix and asymmetry can be tested.
Broad demand weakness is a regime/contradiction input rather than a specific long opportunity.
One-month trade-flow rebound with weather/production-policy confounds lacks persistence and independent verification.
